item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 12/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry continental airstream will bring persistently very hot and fine weather to southern China this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Muifa will move across the seas east of Taiwan and the East China Sea in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 12/09 (Monday)
Wind: North force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly fine with some haze. Very hot and dry during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 34 C
R.H. range: 50 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
